notes.title: Minor Hotfix
notes.content:
Greetings, worthy Souls!

A very small hotfix following up to yesterday's patch:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Resistance pop-up would not appear correctly even when an elemental resistance applied
[*] Fixed an issue with the Extended Effect skill being purchasable during respawn even if the player did not acquire it before losing a life
[/list]

Happy adventuring!

--Runelight Owl

notes.title: Minor Updates and QoL
notes.content:
Greetings, worthy Souls!

This newest update is a relatively small patch that fixes a couple bugs and addresses a long-standing QoL concern. Here are the details:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Counterspell would not appear in the skill carry-over list during respawn
[*] Fixed a bug where the Gold item node in Chapter 2, Area 4 had an incorrect interaction with the Treasure Finder skill
[*] Fixed a bug where the Confuseproof status would not properly prevent Confusion from all sources
[*] Added text in the options menu to make players aware that the F2, F3, and F4 keys work as shortcuts for the FPS display, screen stretch, and full screen options, respectively
[/list]

I'm grateful for the recent influx of active players who have been kind enough to provide great feedback on the game, leading to the improvements above.

Until next time, adventurers!! Thanks for your support!
--Chris (developer, Runelight Owl)

notes.title: Small Updates, 1 Year Later
notes.content:
Greetings, worthy Souls!

It turns out it's already been a year since Soul Survivor: Trials of the Goddess was released! Thanks for all your support throughout that time - our little project has received a lot of great feedback as well as a Positive rating on Steam (of course, additional reviews are always welcome!)

That said, I think this is finally the last content update for Soul Survivor. I plan to move on to my next project (to be announced soon!) and will be working on that in full swing once the store page is ready.

July 9th Changelog:

Fixed a display bug with the item preview card for the Thorn Whip
Fixed a display bug with some items in the Take3 Fight3 campaign in which the preview card wouldn't disappear right away
Added custom hand-drawn (and appropriately pixel-styled) Weakness, Resistance, Critical, and Immunity pop-ups during combat, since the ones generated by the game engine would sometimes render in the incorrect font

notes.title: QoL Updates and Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43167396/867e58a707804fc45d6e80b1ca35af94a0efca78.png[/img]

Greetings, worthy Souls!

The final patch on [i]Soul Survivor: Trials of the Goddess[/i]' development roadmap is here, wrapping up the last few months of accumulated feedback from players as well as a few features that weren't able to make it into the game at launch time.

A handful of text box formatting bugs were squashed, as well as an error which prevented some skills from being permanently learned by consuming Skill Points. The file size of the game client has also been reduced by about 20% by removing some unused files. Map fragments now properly carry over between save files after completing the game. An item in Chapter 1, Area 3 had a broken auto-equip script which is now fixed.

On the features side, a few exciting things have been added:
[list]
[*] A new skill, Preparation, has been added to bolster low-level magic users - while specifically designed for Support casters, multiple builds may find a use for the additional MP economy it brings
[*] Skills with slow cast times have been tagged in the description box, making it easier to find that information in battle (previously it could only be seen from the Skill menu)
[*] The Magic Defense growth of some mid-to-high level foes has been reduced to be more in line with player Magic scaling
[*] The Extended Effect skill now adds a bonus to positive State durations added to the player, and the skill description has been updated accordingly (previously it only extended negative States inflicted on enemies)
[/list]

As always, if any bugs or support issues should arise I will do my best to address them in a timely manner. Barring that, however, there are no further content updates planned for the game.
It has been a long and rewarding journey, and I hope players continue to enjoy [i]Soul Survivor: Trials of the Goddess[/i] as much as I've enjoyed developing it.

Thank you for your downloads, comments, reviews, and support throughout the life of this project!

notes.title: Soul Survivor: Trials of the Goddess Available Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, worthy Souls!

The full [i]Soul Survivor: Trials of the Goddess[/i] experience is finally here - 3 chapters full of exciting battles, clever secrets, and of course tons of choices to be made at every turn.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] 21 total areas, including 3 hidden areas
[*] Deep character customization
[*] Tons of enemies, loot, and secrets to discover
[*] Sixteen Achievements to collect
[*] A unique experience on each run
[*] Choices matter: enemies and resources are both limited
[/list]

And due to a slight delay in publishing this announcement (...oops!) I am happy to report we've already hit the 10 Positive review milestone!

If you haven't already accepted the challenge, drop by and check out our demo!


[i]Will your Soul survive?[/i]
